pages.title: Ghost
pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 100$(br)$(l)Damage$(): 10, every 1.07 s, range 6$(br)$(l)Speed$(): 3.94, on the ground$(br)$(l)Cost$(): 150 minerals, 125 vespene, 2 supply$(br)$(l)Build time$(): 29 s$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()

$(l)Nuke$() (N): arm a nuclear missile in a ghost academy's silo first (100/100, one an academy). The ghost then points a red laser at a place for 10 s while the missile rises out of the academy and falls on the red dot: huge damage round it, a shallow crater. An order to the ghost, or its death, lets the missile go: it blows up small in the air; shot down or striking something on its way, it does the same.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(l)Cloak$(): Invisible to foes without a detector; 25 energy, then 0.9 a second$(br2)$(l)EMP Round$(): Removes shields and energy in the area$(br2)$(l)Steady Targeting$(): After aiming 1.4 s: 170 damage to a biological unit$(br2)$(l)Tactical Nuke$(): Needs a nuke armed at a ghost academy. The ghost lasers the point for 10 s; the missile rises from the academy and falls there: a huge blast. An order or the ghost's death loses it
